parts.title: Once a Year Can't Hurt
parts.original_title: Uno al año no hace daño
parts.overview: It tells the story of a university student who makes a documentary to find out if Colombia is a country of drinkers or not. In the midst of everyday and comic situations, the young man will obtain interesting and entertaining material for his research.

parts.title: Once a Year Can't Hurt 2
parts.original_title: Uno al año no hace daño 2
parts.overview: A sequel to more traditions of a typical Colombian family, this time we will see a bachelor party, Halloween, a heartbreak and much more.
